runtime: ECMAScript module; pure numerical fit/prediction; no dependencies, DOM or filesystem I/O

variants.origin: Automobile/new/Vehickle_calculations_assets/cycle-energy.js; integrate loss/regen/auxiliary balance, composed into a new bounded fit
equations: E_b = k_t * E_w+ - k_r * E_w- + P_aux * t
assumptions: Same tested configuration, meter basis and operating mode within a cohort
k_t is 1..2.5; k_r is 0..1; P_aux is 0..3000 W
Coefficients are effective cohort parameters, not component efficiency maps
Wheel energy may be reconstructed; its assumptions must remain attached

status: provisional offline calibration; no automatic application to vehicle defaults
limitations: Three independent feature columns required; repeated cycles do not create independent test campaigns
No thermal/SOC dependence, fuel balance or plug charging losses
Fit on battery DC basis cannot be used as certified WLTP/EPA outlet consumption
Signed net energy is permitted; unsuitable PHEV mixed-mode observations must be excluded by the cohort builder
implementationAuthority: index.mjs owns the bounded least-squares numerical fit and energy prediction; manifest equation is reference metadata.
